versions.research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 10641 of October 26, 1955, 20 FR 8137 (Oct. 29, 1955), held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10641.txt (FR Doc. 55-8799); it amends the Civil Service Rules by adding Rule VIII, appointments to overseas positions (8.1 to 8.4). Later instruments: EO 12107 (Dec. 28, 1978; 44 FR 1055) sec. 2-101(a) lists EO 10641 among orders amended and revised by substituting Office of Personnel Management for Civil Service Commission, effective January 1, 1979 (secs. 2-104 and 2-404). Its sec. 2-401 asks for a report by July 1, 1981 on continuing, modifying or revoking the listed orders; a report deadline is not an end and no held report or action follows. Number searches of held texts find only EO 10577 (earlier cross reference), EO 12107, the 5 CFR part 301 authority lines and the 5 U.S.C. 3301 note (which lists EO 10641 as amended by EO 12107). No held Revoked by or Superseded by note exists (OFR notes record amendment by EO 12107). Bounded searches read for coverage: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121 USLM text and notes, citations of the order by number, edition current through 2026-10-09, laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 plus GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records plus operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts).

No held instrument ends Rule VIII.","independent_command_check":"Independent commands: EO 10577 (the Civil Service Rules) and later rules added after Rule VIII are separate instruments; nothing in them extends or ends this clause.","savings_check":"No savings question arises: the order remains operative, no ending, repeal or revocation is claimed, and no residual effect separate from the continuing clauses is claimed. The bounded searches found no ending that would leave residual effects.","scope_check":"The single clause is the instruction adding Rule VIII as a whole; EO 12107's substitutions change agency names only, so the clause continues amended. Sections 8.3, 8.4 and the retirement exclusion in 8.2 are parts of the same clause; no held source ends any of them and none is asserted to be ended."}

reviews.reasons: Identity (EO 10641, Oct. 26, 1955, 20 FR 8137, Eisenhower) and quotes check. EO 12107's substitution of OPM for the Commission, effective Jan. 1, 1979, is correctly recorded, and the YES outcome is plausible because Rule VIII remains cited as authority for 5 CFR part 301. But Rule 8.2 is part of this clause, and two later presidential orders say they control over it to the extent of conflict. EO 12362 sec. 4 did so in 1982; EO 12721 sec. 3, which revoked EO 12362 and is noted by the OFR against 5 CFR 8.2, did so in 1990. These orders let certain overseas employees acquire competitive status, which 8.2 denies. The claim neither records nor analyses this partial displacement and says that no later instrument affects the clause. Its search description is also inaccurate. Rejected so the later events and the current scope of 8.2 can be stated.
